actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location. Settings has no "Add-ons" section — all tabs checked (Users, Services, Pricing Rules, Taxes, Promos, Equipment, Amenities, Tags, Customers, Scheduling, Waivers, Prerequisites, Age groups, Leads, Notifications, Communications, Assistant). Equipment is a price-less inventory and Amenities is a single "test" row, so there are no "Elite coach" or "Equipment" add-ons to price at $5/session or $25, no class price form to add them to (see QXR-576), and consequently nothing to deactivate or show on an invoice — no add-on or Discount invoice lines can be produced.
expected: Settings > Add-ons shows Elite coach and Equipment; they can be priced and added to a class; deactivating removes them for new purchases but keeps them on old ones; the invoice shows the add-on lines and one Discount line.
steps: Open Settings and list every tab; look for Add-ons.
Check Equipment and Amenities for priced add-ons.
Open a class price form and look for add-on controls.
Check an invoice for add-on and Discount lines.
title: QXR-587: no add-ons surface — no Add-ons section in Settings, no priced Elite coach / Equipment add-ons
